title: Élyséa's Lore
prerequisite: Elf, Drow, Fir Bolg or Halfling
description:
What Élyséa gave the last Galwarians has come down to you.

The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} {{SAVELY-001|this Skill}}, unlock a Domain Tree you do not have yet and {{apprise|learn}} the {{competence}} at the heart of that Tree, both for free.
